environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but the namespace 'processing' has a label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted applied at the namespace level. The restricted Pod Security Standard (PSS) is enforced via the built-in Pod Security Admission controller (not a third-party policy engine). Additionally, the cluster has a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (v1beta1, feature gate enabled) that rejects any pod spec containing spec.volumes[*].hostPath or spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged=true. The container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and an emptyDir volume is mounted at /var/data/attachments with a 100Mi sizeLimit. The node's kubelet is configured with --protect-kernel-defaults=true and the container's seccomp profile is set to RuntimeDefault.
